Hernkyn Pioneer Bike
Large Kin skimmer
AC 15 | HP 45 | DT 5 | Speed 80 ft | Handling +2
Crew 1 D | Passengers 0 | Cargo 100 kg | Rare
Weapons: forward magna-coil autocannon (D). Exposed. Low skimmer: ignores ground-level difficult terrain and 
crosses calm water while its grav drive works. Kin controls need familiarisation or refitting for others; no Ogryn 
accommodation.
